records.title: Best place to have your money
records.review:
One of the most versatile financial apps I’ve used

I’m genuinely very impressed with Revolut. It has become one of the most versatile financial platforms I use, and the fact that it is now a bank makes it even more appealing.

One of the biggest strengths for me is how seamless it is to move money between different currencies and countries. The foreign exchange experience is incredibly straightforward, and transferring between currencies is quick and effortless.

The app itself is exceptionally fast and responsive. It opens quickly, navigation is smooth, and the different financial services are well integrated into one platform.

I’m a Metal customer, so I do pay for the premium service, but I’ve found the overall range of features very impressive. Beyond everyday banking, you can access savings and interest-bearing accounts, ISAs, investments, stocks and even commodities. There are also cryptocurrency services for those who are interested in that area.

Having so many different financial services accessible through one app makes Revolut extremely versatile. Whether you’re managing money across countries, exchanging currencies, saving, or investing, the experience is generally seamless.

Overall, I’m very impressed with Revolut and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a modern, versatile financial platform.

records.title: Used this app for years
records.review:
I’ve been using Revolut for years now and it’s genuinely become one of those apps I couldn’t imagine not having on my phone. It makes managing money simple, quick and stress-free, and everything feels like it’s been designed with the customer in mind.

From everyday spending and keeping track of where my money is going, to transfers and managing everything in one place, it’s always been incredibly convenient. The app is clean, easy to understand and constantly seems to improve rather than becoming more complicated.

What impresses me most is how much control it gives you over your own money. You can see what’s happening straight away instead of having to dig through confusing menus or wait around to find information. After using it for this long, I’ve come to trust and rely on it for my day-to-day finances.

There aren’t many apps I’ve kept using consistently for years, but Revolut is one of them. It has genuinely changed the way I manage my money for the better. An easy 5 stars from me and absolutely deserved.

records.title: Great banking offering
records.review:
Really enjoying Revolut. The app is simple to use with countless great features. 

I have a great savings rate(currently 5% with interest paid daily) and have bought commodities (gold and silver) within the app, opened a stocks and shares isa, and this week transferred my mobile phone provider to Revolut. You can pay your phone using the rev points you acquire through day to day spending. 

I was with an established mainstream bank for 30 years until I used the current account switching service to move to Revolut - genuinely can’t fault the move or my decision. 

I was a little dubious about using a chat feature instead of speaking to a call centre if I had an issue or needed help, but Revolut’s chat feature has been far quicker and easier than making a call, and has 
resolved the few queries (mainly around how to set things up how I want them in the app) with ease. 

I pay for the metal plan - £14.99 a month, as all of the benefits that come with it are perfect for me.

One thing to note is that Revolut don’t currently offer lending products like loans or overdrafts, but I’m hoping that now they have a full UK banking licence this won’t be far away. 

All in all, a top draw bank and service offering.
